answer: A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 15 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes an umber bet on surviving 59 epochs of grading, and every prism settlement recomputes the juniper schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 59 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 17 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
